第85章 清晨去电鱼-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“这年轻人，体力怎么这么好？”老刘大口大口喘着粗气，望着已经没影的李青山道。

“年轻的时候就没用，怎么老了还这么没用！”

中年女人也一路小跑追了过来，气呼呼道：“算了，等梦倩回来的时候，诈她一下，说不定真是她！”

“要真是她的话，你怎么跟你哥交代？”老刘开口道。

“再说吧！”

“梦倩，刚刚那谁啊？”

幽深的小巷子内，李青山望着近在咫尺的梦倩道。

“就我爹的战友，要是被发现可就惨了，不说了，我得先回去了。”

梦倩说罢，站回了地上，旋即四下看看无人，朝着李青山招了招手道：“李青山，你过来一下！”

“咋了？”

李青山微微一怔，轻轻弯腰。

下一刻。

便感觉一股柔软宛若蜻蜓点水，从唇边划过，还夹杂着几分少女的清甜和香味。

“走啦，你路上小心点！”

梦倩朝着身后李青山挥了挥手，头也不回的跑掉了，这大晚上的李青山有些担心，便跟在后面，看着上了小楼的二楼，房间内亮了灯后，这才缓缓离开。

二楼的窗户后，梦倩脸上满是润红和喜悦，望着李青山在黑暗中的背影逐渐远去，心中更是泛起一抹甜暗道：“这糙汉，心思还挺缜密的呢。”

土乡的另外一处民房内。

许晚吟想着今天晚上的事情，则是怎么都睡不着，心中暗自懊悔，早知道当时就先让李青山送梦倩回家了，然后再送自己回家。

相比于梦倩的性格，许晚吟觉得自己的性格还是太过于被动，没有主动性，这个坏习惯，以后得好好改一改。

也不知道梦倩那小狐狸放李青山回家了没。

他们现在干什么呢？

李青山回到家后，都已经半夜十一点了，村里小路上早就没人了，只有路边草丛内时不时传来蟋蟀和蝈蝈，以及各种夜晚出动的鸟类和野物的叫声。

这个年代的农村，尚且没有经过如何工业化的污染。

天上繁星密密，月光皎洁，大晚上的就算是不用烛火，都能看得清小路。

"How come this young man has such good physical strength?" Lao Liu gasped for air and looked at Li Qingshan who had disappeared.

"You were useless when you were young, why are you so useless when you are old!"

The middle-aged woman also ran after her and said angrily: "Forget it, when Meng Qian comes back, trick her, maybe it's really her!"

"If it's really her, how do you explain it to your brother?" Lao Liu said.

"Let's talk again!"

"Mengqian, who was that just now?"

In the deep alley, Li Qingshan looked at Meng Qian who was very close at hand.

"As for my father's comrades, it would be terrible if they were discovered. I won't say anything anymore. I have to go back first."

After Meng Qian finished speaking, she stood back on the ground. She immediately looked around to see if there was no one around. She waved to Li Qingshan and said, "Li Qingshan, come here!"

"What's wrong?"

Li Qingshan was slightly startled and bent down slightly.

The next moment.

Then I felt a softness, like a dragonfly touching water, passing through my lips, mixed with a bit of girlish sweetness and fragrance.

"Let's go, be careful on the road!"

Meng Qian waved to Li Qingshan behind her and ran away without looking back. Li Qingshan was a little worried at this late night, so he followed behind and watched as they climbed to the second floor of the small building. After the lights were on in the room, he slowly left.

Behind the window on the second floor, Meng Qian's face was full of blush and joy. She watched Li Qingshan's back gradually disappearing in the darkness, and a hint of sweetness emerged in her heart as she said, "This rough guy is quite thoughtful."

In another private house in Tuxiang.

Xu Wanyin couldn't fall asleep thinking about what happened tonight, and secretly regretted it. If he had known that, he would have asked Li Qingshan to send Mengqian home first, and then send him home.

Compared with Meng Qian's character, Xu Wanyin felt that his character was still too passive and lacked initiative. This bad habit must be changed in the future.

I don’t know if Meng Qian’s little fox let Li Qingshan go home.

What are they doing now?

After Li Qingshan returned home, it was already eleven o'clock in the middle of the night. There was no one on the village road. Only the sounds of crickets and grasshoppers, as well as various birds and wild animals that went out at night, could be heard from time to time in the grass on the roadside.

The rural areas of this era have not yet been polluted by industrialization.

There are so many stars in the sky and the moonlight is so bright that you can see the path clearly at night even without candlelight.
